sources.heading: ~NE, steep upward (estimated from content; not in metadata)
sources.shows: W face as continuous horizontal floor lines over dark blue-black glass (in shade); thin cream cornice slab over recessed bronze top level; cream stucco garden walls and fencing at grade; podium terrace with glass rail

sources.heading: ~N/NE, steep upward (estimated)
sources.shows: S end shaft clad in tan ledgestone (random-length horizontal strips, 2 tones); a vertical strip of bronze glazing with stepped per-floor bay frames on the S end; cream stucco frame wrapping the glass face; cantilevered flat roof slab ~2-3 m overhang (estimate); red letters high on the S end (unreadable)

sources.heading: ~W (looking at the E face; estimated from sign pier on right = north)
sources.shows: E face glass with projecting light fins at every floor (~16 fin bands counted); two narrow ledgestone piers splitting the glass ~1/3 from the S end; recessed top level with stepped curved roof canopies and rooftop palms; N end ledgestone pier with "red rock / CASINO" sign; podium base red sandstone stacked stone + cream box

sources.heading: ~W (same viewpoint family as rr-c2010-hotel)
sources.shows: Night: fins lit, one per floor (~16 bands + top level); sign letters lit white

sources.heading: ~E (description: "Looking east"); taken from the podium roof
sources.shows: W face as one glass field in a cream stucco frame (~1 floor deep top band), flush horizontal lines per floor (no projecting fins seen), bronze/rose reflective glass; recessed top floor with small punched windows; N ledgestone pier with "red rock CASINO" (purple/maroon) sign; podium roof white membrane, AHU box, dishes, ~1.5-2 m cream parapet screen (estimate)

sources.heading: ~E/NE from pool terrace (estimated)
sources.shows: Same W-face composition as 2018; bronze reflective glass; podium plinth band under the glass

sources.heading: ~W/NW from an upper tower floor (estimated from the Spring Mountains in view)
sources.shows: Podium: cream stucco walls with red-stone accent panels, flat roofs with parapets and HVAC, round drum with wood soffit near pool, terraces on the courtyard side

sources.heading: ~S/SE (estimated)
coverage: restaurant row/casino NW entrance (w316302063/w316302064 NW corner)
sources.shows: Yard House pylon (gray stacked stone); cream ledgestone band with swept cornice; red sandstone piers framing glass doors; white box canopy carrying silver "CASINO" letters (~1-1.2 m, estimate vs ~2.4-3 m doors); upper glazing under flat roof with wood soffit; lower restaurant bays with light stone piers and dark awnings

sources.heading: unknown
sources.shows: Same entrance vocabulary as the NW entrance: red sandstone piers, white box canopy with "CASINO", wood-soffit roof slab; red-rock monolith fountain sign "red rock RESORT SPA"

sources.heading: ~N/NW across the pool (estimated)
sources.shows: Courtyard face: 3 cream stucco bands with recessed terraces, red sandstone pilasters/chimneys, curved wood-soffit canopy at left

sources.heading: ~NE (estimated)
sources.shows: Tower W face lower floors behind palms; context only

sources.heading: unknown
